title: Efficacy and Safety of Eloralintide (LY3841136) in Participants With Osteoarthritis Knee Pain and Obesity or Overweight ( ENLIGHTEN-4)
official: J3R-MC-YDAN - A Master Protocol for Phase 3 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Studies to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Once Weekly Eloralintide in Adult Participants with Osteoarthritis Knee Pain, and Obesity or Overweight (ENLIGHTEN-4) J3R-MC-YOA1: Intervention-Specific Appendix 1 (ISA1) for Eloralintide in Participants with Osteoarthritis Knee Pain J3R-MC-YOA2: Intervention-Specific Appendix 2 (ISA2) for Eloralintide in Participants with Osteoarthritis Knee Pain
summary:
Main objective: The two independent primary objectives are: 
Percent Change from Baseline in Body Weight.
Change from Baseline in the Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC) Pain Subscale Score.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Have a body mass index (BMI) of 27 kilograms per square meter (kg/m²) or higher at screening
2. Have a stable body weight (less than 5% body weight change) for 90 days prior to screening
3. Have tried at least once to lose weight through diet but were unsuccessful
4. Have osteoarthritis of the knee and at least one of the following conditions;  Be over 50 years old, Have morning knee stiffness that lasts about 30 minutes, Have a crackling or grinding sound or feeling in the knee
Exclusion criteria:
1. Have an active knee infection
2. Have had or are planning to have surgery, an endoscopic procedure, and/or device based therapy for weight loss (with exceptions)
3. Have type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, or any other type of diabetes
4. Have taken certain medications for blood sugar within 90 days prior to screening
5. Have had a serious heart condition within 90 days prior to screening
6. Have taken medications or alternative remedies intended for weight loss within 90  days prior to screening
